findingDetails.title: Catalog leaf asserts a parity the code does not have
findingDetails.evidence: The leaf states the orchestrator reads every present doc and the mirror reads a subset, then says both answer with the same verdict; an unstamped goal.md token errors in orchestrator.ts:720-747 and is never opened by check-placeholders.sh:107-111.
findingDetails.recommendation: Qualify the leaf to name the orchestrator as the authoritative gate and the mirror as a subset, or align the mirror's doc list and markers.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Leaf and both implementations read directly; doc-set difference visible in orchestrator.ts:720 versus check-placeholders.sh:107-111.

findingDetails.title: Parity test pins four cells and none of the divergent shapes
findingDetails.evidence: The five tests cover four lifecycle cells on spec.md at Level 2; no test covers the doc-set difference, the angle-bracket form, the [template: title token, indented fences, or inline spans with leading text.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a table-driven parity test over those five shapes.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Test file read end to end; shell and orchestrator patterns compared line by line.

findingDetails.title: The authoring card's token count covers three documents, the gate covers six
findingDetails.evidence: Step 8's verify command counts tokens in spec.md, plan.md and tasks.md only; the orchestrator also scans acceptance-criteria.md, implementation-summary.md and goal.md when stamped, so a token left there passes the card's acceptance line.
findingDetails.recommendation: Extend the count command to the other three documents, or state that the validator is the authoritative count.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Card read end to end; orchestrator doc list read at orchestrator.ts:505-519,720.

results.summary: Four lifecycle cells match REQ-002; the unqualified agreement reading does not survive the doc-set and marker differences.
The catalog leaf's parity claim is contradicted by the code it documents.

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new to this lineage; iteration 1 is the first pass and no prior registry entries exist.
